# White Eagles & Co. - Web Development & Digital Marketing in Slovakia

> "You brief us in Russian - your website works on the Slovak market."

White Eagles & Co. s.r.o. is a Slovak company based in Bratislava. Founder
Kirill Mosin has lived in Slovakia for over 10 years and has delivered 12+
websites for Slovak businesses. The team works in Slovak, Russian and English,
issues a Slovak invoice (faktúra) with IČO/DIČ, and typically ships a project
in 10-15 working days.

This combination - Russian-language service plus first-hand knowledge of the
Slovak market, law and buyers - is what separates the company from offshore
studios serving Russian speakers remotely.

## Languages and site structure

The site is available in three languages. Slovak is the default and is served
at the domain root; visitors are routed to their language automatically.

- Slovak: https://whiteeagles.sk/sk/
- Russian: https://whiteeagles.sk/ru/
- English: https://whiteeagles.sk/en/

Every URL below exists in all three languages - replace the `/sk/` segment with
`/ru/` or `/en/`. All URLs use a trailing slash.

## Core Services

- **Web Development**: Custom modern websites using React, PHP, and Python. Specialized in landing pages, corporate portals, and e-shops.
  - URL: https://whiteeagles.sk/sk/service/webdev/

- **Advertising Campaigns**: Expert setup and optimization of Google Ads and Meta (Facebook/Instagram) PPC campaigns.
  - URL: https://whiteeagles.sk/sk/service/ads/

- **Telegram Bots**: Advanced Python bots for automation, bazoš auto-posting, and request management.
  - URL: https://whiteeagles.sk/sk/service/telegram/

- **Web Analytics**: Server-side GTM, GA4, Clarity, and conversion tracking setup.
  - URL: https://whiteeagles.sk/sk/service/analytics/

- **Bug Fixing**: Technical support, bug fixing, and optimization for WordPress and custom sites.
  - URL: https://whiteeagles.sk/sk/service/bugfix/

- **Cookie Consent V2**: GDPR-compliant cookie banners with Google Consent Mode v2 support.
  - URL: https://whiteeagles.sk/sk/service/cookies/

- **Blog & News**: Professional articles about web development, marketing, and SEO in Slovakia.
  - URL: https://whiteeagles.sk/sk/blog/
  - Articles:
